Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance 
procedures P2, to be performed every seven years as indicated by Y7 in the above 
title block
Technical Specification of Turbine driving FWP
Data sheet | 
Manufacturer | Franco Tosi
Impulse type turbine | TV SA 1174
Serial number | 5561
C.P.O. | 15363
Year of manufacture | 1988
Rating | 8850 kW
Operating speed | 5500 rpm
1st critical speed | 3550 rpm
2nd critical speed | 7450 rpm
Max continuous speed | 5920 rpm
Over speed trip | 6350 rpm
Steam conditions | 
Main steam | 178 Kg/cm2 /538 o C
Main turbine extraction steam | 8.92 kg/ o C / 341 o C
Control system | 
SIE Electrohydraulic control system, type 
 ENC 1001 PM2
Turbine supervisory instruments (TSI)
CEMB T-RACK 80
The first draft initiated by eng. Ragab Goada 
 Abo-Zeed tested by eng. Emad Abraheem Gooda, accepted by general manager eng. 
 Hassan Saeed Dosoki , approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of 
 Damanhour power station and 
 certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head 
 sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes gloves ... etc
Shutdown the turbine
Isolate the steam to turbine.
The oil system of turbine must be isolated 
 mechanically and electrically.
Be sure turbine must be completely drained.
Circuit breaker of 
 turning gear racked out
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Special tools for turbine.
Cleaning fluid, rags 
 manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge
Checking shaft.
Lifting device of rotors.
Lifting device of 
 casings.
Heating device of bolts 
 including heating elements and templates for bolts tightening.
Special wrench.
Assembly guide of 
 casings.
Transport stands of 
 rotors.
rotor stand
Work to be carried out
The time interval between two major overhauls, 
based on actual experience, is approx. 7 years, during which the unit has been 
kept in service for a minimum of 40,000 hours to a maximum of 60,000 hours. This 
time, however, will also depend on the type of operation performed. For that 
reason, it is recommended that a regular schedule of all outages, their causes 
and durations he set up monthly or every two or three months. It is also 
suggested that the data recorder be placed at manufactures disposal to give him 
useful information to determine the kind of inspection and the nature of. the 
action to be taken during the next overhaul, even though the work will not be 
performed under his supervision.
The operations to be done on that occasion, in addition to those required 
for annual maintenance, are basically the following:
Dismantling 
 of turbine cylinder and removal of rotor
Visual inspection and nondestructive tests of 
 stationary and rotating parts
NonDestructive 
Testing (NDT)
The normal practice is to perform checks as 
extensive as possible. The overhaul program should include the following check 
means:
Liquid Penetrant Inspection (LP)
Magnetic Particle Inspection (MX)
Ultrasonic Testing (US)
Liquid Penetrant Inspection (LP)
Magnetic Particle Inspection (MX)
Ultrasonic Testing (US)
Stationary parts
Cylinder | LP 
 or MX inspection on critical points, at the various cylinder Section 
 variations. Weld inspection on stop valve, piping and connecting axial 
 beams.
Stationary blades | LP inspection
Nozzle chambers | LP and MX inspection
 of nozzle
block and welding | 
Bolting | LP Inspection
Pipings | LP and MX inspection
Rotating parts
Blading, shrouds, LP inspection tenons.
Rotor LP inspection on rotor recesses and gland 
 zones
Welding inspection
A non-destructive test is recommended for all 
accessible welds working at high pressures and temperatures
.Inspection 
 of all bearings
Check of alignment of stationary 
 parts with rotor axis
Check of rotor alignment
Oil system overhaul
The following operations are recommended:
Oil pumps overhaul.
Inspection of valves in oil 
 system.
Water test and cleaning of cooler 
 tube bundle water side.
Inspection of Gland Steam 
Sealing System
It will consist in inspecting valves and 
servomotors and checking the opening sequence.
Inspection of Turning Gear
Overhaul of Protective Devices
